name: Center-Zero Laboratory Moving Coil Galvanometer
semanticDescription: Laboratory-grade center-zero moving-coil galvanometer (-30 to +30 scale with central zero indicator and bold G emblem) for detecting presence and direction of induced electric currents in electromagnetic induction experiments (NCERT Class 10 Chapter 12 and Class 12 Physics Chapter 4). Features dual presentation collections: Galvanometer_Full (complete bench instrument in molded black Bakelite casing, front glass window, crimson needle, mechanical zero-adjustment screw, top knurled brass binding posts on studio slate plinth) and Galvanometer_Section (cutaway revealing internal electromechanical movement: permanent horseshoe magnet with concave cylindrical pole shoes, soft iron core, rectangular copper wire coil, phosphor-bronze spiral hairsprings, radial magnetic field lines, and educational plaque on brass stanchions).
simplifications: Coil winding represented as high-density layered copper form.
Radial magnetic field visualized via discrete luminescent flux vectors.

materials.look: Molded black phenolic Bakelite instrument casing
Crisp white matte printed scale face with center zero and bold G
Crimson red lightweight aluminum indicator pointer
Concave cylindrical North (red) and South (blue) permanent magnet pole shoes
High-permeability machined soft iron central cylinder
High-luster enameled copper magnet wire turns
Luminescent cyan radial magnetic field vectors
Dark studio slate display pedestal with satin gold trim
